contract.purpose: Collect material on typed decision models (Jev by TypeSafe) and on building software with them.
core: Typed decision models such as Jev: choice, noul and score primitives, confidence and calibration
Engineering integrations of decision models: state design, question banks, receipts and gates
adjacent: LLM-as-judge and classifier evaluation methods, kept for comparison with decision models
Retrieval and reranking pipelines, kept because decision models are used as rerankers
collected_on_purpose: OpenRouter and TypeSafe API reference pages and SDK READMEs
out_of_scope: Consumer product reviews with no AI component

document.title: Choice, noul and score: how Jev answers typed questions
document.excerpt: Jev returns a probability of yes for a noul, a distribution over options for a choice and an expected level for a score. Confidence measures how peaked the distribution is, and thresholds should be calibrated per action.
